title: The Workshop sign floats above the roof
what: In day-7 the Workshop sign hangs 0.6 m above the roof with nothing holding it.
causes: A visitor walking by sees a sign in the air; it looks broken, not built.

title: The garden is almost black at noon
what: From the garden door at noon, most of the picture is under 10% brightness.
causes: The garden looks empty; its works cannot be seen.

title: Merge keeps coming back to "loop"
what: In the 7-day real run, 5 of 7 days had "loop" among the top topics; the longest run was 4 days.
causes: Merge's works and diary read the same day after day.

title: No memes: they stop at "seen by the planner"
what: Meme formats were offered 12 times and read 4 times, but no plan named one (seen by the planner: 0).
causes: Merge never makes a meme, which Roman asked for.

title: Mastodon trends is promised but not on the list
what: qa/sources.json names Mastodon trends as a pulse source; it is blocked by robots.txt for ClaudeBot.
causes: Merge has one pulse source (Imgflip) instead of three.

title: /health says the sandbox is missing
causes: Build sessions cannot run, so Merge has nine verbs instead of ten.

title: A check did not run: the frame rate
what: The check world.fps stopped with: the browser did not start.
causes: Nothing is known about what this check looks at, so a problem there could go unseen.
